replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Honestly, I never enjoyed it. In school, it felt too rigid and disconnected from real life. I struggled in exams, and even now, at 25, I find it intimidating. I prefer subjects like economics and biology, where I can see practical value. Math feels abstract and uninteresting to me, so I keep it at a basic level and avoid diving deeper.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, yes. If a colleague or friend suddenly asks me to solve a problem, my stomach tightens. It's not a panic disorder, but more like social anxiety tied to my lack of confidence. I worry about being judged or looking foolish. I'd rather talk about my favorite subjects like biology or hiking than risk a math conversation.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, not really. I don't see the point since I never need to use advanced math in my job. My current role doesn't require complex calculations. I've tried asking an AI once or twice out of curiosity, but the explanations felt too technical and overwhelming. It didn't help; it just made me feel more inadequate.
